info.title: Zscaler Private Access API Portal
info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

put.summary: Updates the Auto Delete frequency for the disconnected ZPA Private Service Edge by the specified Auto Delete configuration ID.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the ZPA Private Service Edge auto-deletion configuration for a customer. This field is only required for the PUT request to update the frequency of the ZPA Private Service Edge settings.

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained in the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations are limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

id.description: The unique identifier for the App Connector or ZPA Private Service Edge auto-deletion configuration for a customer. This field is only required for the PUT request to update the frequency of the App Connector or ZPA Private Service Edge settings.

frequencyInterval.description: The interval for the configured frequency value. The minimum supported value is 5.

frequency.description: The scheduled frequency at which the disconnected App Connectors or ZPA Private Service Edges are deleted.

enabled.description: Indicates if the setting for deleting App Connectors or ZPA Private Service Edges is enabled or disabled.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

deleteDisabled.description: Indicates if the App Connectors or ZPA Private Service Edges are included for deletion if they are in a disconnected state based on the frequencyInterval and frequency values.

publishIps.description: The list of published IP addresses.

publishIpv6.description: Enable to automatically publish both IPv4 and IPv6 IP addresses if a Publish IP address or domain isn't configured. When enabled, Zscaler Client Connector can receive both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Disable to only publish IPv4 IP addresses. By default, this field is disabled.

longitude.description: The longitude of the ZPA Private Service Edge.

location.description: The location of the ZPA Private Service Edge.

expectedVersion.description: The expected version of the ZPA Private Service Edge. This field has read-only properties, and is ignored in POST and PUT requests.

previousVersion.description: The previous version of the ZPA Private Service Edge. This field has read-only properties, and is ignored in POST and PUT requests.

lastUpgradeTime.description: The time the ZPA Private Service Edge last upgraded. This field has read-only properties, and is ignored in POST and PUT requests.

expectedUpgradeTime.description: The expected upgrade time of the ZPA Private Service Edge. This field has read-only properties and is ignored in POST and PUT requests.

upgradeStatus.description: The status of the ZPA Private Service Edge upgrade. This field has read-only properties, and is ignored in POST and PUT requests.

restartInstructions.description:
Arbitrary text field for storing instructions that need to be performed before restart. The supported values are:
  • DELETE: Deletes all configuration states for the instance.
  • FLUSHDB: Deletes all content of a configuration stored by the software.

upgradeNowOnce.description: Whether or not the ZPA Private Service Edge is upgraded to a new version only once. If set to true, the ZPA Private Service Edge upgrades to the new version and then resets this field to false.
